result.topic_en: Calculations on the PDE $(\partial\vartheta/\partial x)^2+(\partial\vartheta/\partial y)^2+(\partial\vartheta/\partial z)^2=\text{const}$ via a Legendre-type transformation, seeking solutions of the form $s=\psi(p^2+q^2+r^2)+\dots$ and a condition giving $\psi'\propto m^{-3/4}$, together with side calculations on linear relations among coefficients $k,k',l,l'$.
result.transcription:
$\left(\frac{\partial\vartheta}{\partial x}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial\vartheta}{\partial y}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial\vartheta}{\partial z}\right)^2=\text{const}$
$p=\frac{\partial\vartheta}{\partial x}\quad q=\frac{\partial\vartheta}{\partial y}\quad r=\frac{\partial\vartheta}{\partial z}$
$\vartheta-px-qy-rz=s$
$\delta s=[-\delta\vartheta-]-x\delta p-y\delta q-z\delta r$
$\frac{\partial s}{\partial p}=-x$
$\frac{\partial s}{\partial q}=-y$
$\frac{\partial s}{\partial r}=-z$

$\beta=px+qy+rz+s$

$ry-zq+r\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial q}=0$

$\psi(m)-\psi'(m)\,2m=\varphi(m)$
